task_definition.task_name: Probabilistic Power Spectral Density Estimation and Visualization

task_description.overview: Compute and visualize probabilistic power spectral densities (PPSDs) for seismic noise analysis and site quality control.
steps: Load seismic waveform data for the desired station/channel combination from provided URLs or local files.
Load station metadata (response information) from a StationXML, RESP file, or dataless SEED using ObsPy's read_inventory or Parser.
Initialize a PPSD object with the trace statistics and metadata.
Add one-hour segments of the seismic data (Stream or Trace) to the PPSD instance; the object will reject overlapping segments.
Inspect the processed time segments and data gaps via ppsd.times_processed, ppsd.times_data, and ppsd.times_gaps.
Generate visualizations: histogram-based PPSD plot, cumulative PPSD plot, temporal PSD time series, and spectrogram-like plots.
Optionally save the plots to image files (PNG, PDF) and apply custom colormaps (e.g., PQLX).

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Compute and visualize the probabilistic power spectral density (PPSD) for station BW.KW1..EHZ channel. Load waveform data from {seismic_waveform_path} and station metadata from {station_metadata_path}. Initialize a PPSD object (obspy.signal.PPSD), add the data streams, and ensure no overlapping segments. After processing, produce the standard PPSD histogram, a cumulative histogram, a temporal PSD plot for frequencies {plot_parameters.temporal_frequencies}, and a spectrogram-like plot. 
 Note: 1) Save the ppsd histogram plot to {ppsd_histogram_plot}, the ppsd cumulative plot to {ppsd_cumulative_plot}, the ppsd temporal plot to {ppsd_temporal_plot}, and the ppsd spectrogram plot to {ppsd_spectrogram_plot}.
